title: A Modular Structure Theorem for Minimal Periodic Decompositions and Periodicity of Configurations with $P_η(4,n) \leq 4n$
summary: Nivat's conjecture asserts that every two-dimensional configuration $η: \mathbb{Z}^2 \to \mathcal{A}$ whose rectangular pattern complexity satisfies $P_η(k,n) \leq kn$ for some $k,n \in \mathbb{N}$ is periodic. A theorem of Cyr and Kra \cite{CyrKra16} establishes the conjecture in the short-rectangle case $P_η(k,n) \leq kn$, with $k \leq 3$.
